user.title: Music Assistant
user.description: Kids Dashboard reads the audiobooks, their collections and chapters, and the podcasts straight from Music Assistant. Give each child a user of its own in Music Assistant, sign in as that user and make a long-lived token there. This first token makes the first child's profile; add the others afterwards.

data.token: Music Assistant token of the child's user

error.cannot_connect: Music Assistant could not be reached, or it refused the token.

abort.already_configured: Kids Dashboard is already set up.

user.title: Profile
user.description: A child's profile: sign in to Music Assistant as the child's own user and make a long-lived token there. The profile is named after that user; a card picks it with `profile:`.

data.token: Music Assistant token of the child's user

error.cannot_connect: Music Assistant could not be reached, or it refused the token.

abort.already_configured: This Music Assistant user has a profile already.
